result.finding: No network ports are exposed. The rabbitmq-sender is a standalone background message producer with no HTTP server, no web endpoints, and no inbound network listeners. It communicates outbound-only to Azure Service Bus.
evidence: No Dockerfile EXPOSE instruction (no Dockerfile exists)
No docker-compose ports section (no docker-compose file exists)
No Kubernetes containerPort or servicePort found
Application is a one-shot producer that sends messages and exits
